1.why: All seven screens are static, flat panels with no carousels, animations, or modal pop-ups; the only extra panel is a fixed log box.

2.why: Each screen has one bold heading and one dark-blue primary button that clearly dominates, though the large dark 'Logs' panel competes visually for attention.

3.why: Single-task screens with a visible 4-step progress tracker and one obvious next action make the needed control easy to locate, though the required code is buried in a technical log panel.

4.why: The stepper and on-screen instructions reduce load, but she still must transcribe long codes (e.g., l23X2fJfqmWeqJGgaUMH0TbsvE3Fay6s) and recall the 12-character password rule set.

5.why: No password manager hint, autofill affordance, 'remember me' checkbox, or show-password toggle appears anywhere in the login or reset screens.

6.why: No saved username, stored email, avatar, or previously recognised device is displayed; the only persistent element is the raw log history.

7.why: Every screen uses one or two short plain-language sentences such as 'Choose one clear next step. There is no on-screen time pressure.'

8.why: No error state is shown in any screenshot, so there is no evidence of messages that name the problem and its fix.

9.why: Password requirements are stated in words but no sample password, input placeholder, or worked example of code entry is provided.

10.why: Options are plainly labelled ('Reset a forgotten password', 'Sign in', 'Verify code', 'Request a new code'), though no biometric/face option exists.

11.why: Each screen offers at most three buttons, and most offer only one primary action.

12.why: Green confirmation banners, an updating step tracker, and cumulative log entries ('MFA verification completed.') report each outcome, though feedback is partly in technical log language.

13.why: A 'Help and safety' expander appears on all seven screens along with a short instructional line under each step heading and a persistent footer help note.

14.why: 'Request a new code' and 'Continue using simulated link' allow retry at step 2, but no visible back button or edit link exists on the password, privacy, or confirmation screens.

15.why: Identical header, stepper, card layout, button styling, help expander, and footer are repeated on every screen.
